answer: Every agent holds one marble, and a vouch counts only when that marble crosses a bridge out of its own island, paying a toll of $40 times the square of the marble count crossing that bridge in one epoch. A whisper of trust across a cut carries real money, so moving 100 clones across one bridge costs $400,000 in tolls while 100 honest agents pay $4,000 total. Three rotating auditors sample each bridge every week, and one exposed fake burns every marble tied to its lot. A toll road that charges by the square of traffic bankrupts a clone island trying to cross.
